series_name: Federal Funds Effective Rate, daily (synthetic stand-in)

_designed_so_that.step_down: Slicing the series to end at 2025-02-25 gives 4.33 against a previous 4.48 => -0.15 percentage points, exercising a decrease
_designed_so_that.unchanged_is_normal: The effective rate holds flat for long stretches between policy moves. Four consecutive identical observations below reflect that; an unchanged reading is the normal case, not a finding.
_designed_so_that.calendar_gap: There is deliberately no observation for 2025-02-22 or 2025-02-23 (a weekend). 'Previous' means the immediately preceding AVAILABLE observation, not a fixed one-day calendar lag, so gaps do not distort the change.
_designed_so_that.not_the_target_range: DFF is the realised overnight market rate. It is NOT the FOMC target range, which is a separate concept and is not part of V1.
